impact_scope.description: A new public Netpbm decoder lifecycle entry point permits restarting frame 0 using its recorded I/O position.

evidence: S0 contains no matching declaration because the Netpbm production source file and decoder.restart_frame! did not exist.
Therefore H0 had no obligation in S0 to expose this exact Netpbm lifecycle entry point.
S1 introduces pub func decoder.restart_frame!(index, io_position), which validates lifecycle state and changes call_sequence to 0x28.

H0 constructs only a wuffs_bmp__decoder and its helper calls decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, frame_dirty_rect, and workbuf_len; it never constructs a Netpbm decoder or calls restart_frame!.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 would need to instantiate and expose the new Netpbm decoder and add a restart_frame! lifecycle call with caller-supplied index and I/O position after the required prior decoding state.
evidence: The new API requires caller-provided index and io_position values.
Its call_sequence checks make invocation order caller-visible and require a lifecycle transition that was impossible and unnecessary in S0.

reason: The anchored public lifecycle declaration is absent in S0 and introduced in S1. Its exact exposure gap is therefore false before and true after. H0's existing BMP-only image-decoder path does not reach the new Netpbm decoder or invoke restart_frame!, so the fixed truth table yields NEW and requires harness maintenance.
